description:
One Port St. This is the one.

Luxury apartments to rent in Manchester's iconic Northern Quarter. A range of one, two and three bedroom apartments to suit every lifestyle, with beautiful interiors, incredible city centre views and even more beyond your front door. 

Start your next chapter in a home that offers you more with unrivalled amenity spaces, including a 2,000 sq ft leisure suite with a swimming pool and spa pool, a resident gymnasium, 7th floor roof terrace, urban garden, private hire space, grand lobby with 360 firepit, residents lounge, co-working space, and even a secret room reserved just for residents. 

Live in the centre of The Northern Quarter's most luxurious address. Step outside your door into a vibrant neighbourhood full of character, where historic buildings meet cobbled streets and quirky art. Known as Manchester's cultural heart, the area is full of local businesses, vintage shops, trendy cafe's, incredible restaurants and lively bars ready for you to explore.

It's in all the small touches and big experiences at One Port St, we've designed every single thing to make your dream home a reality. From a simple rental process with our established in-house property management team and our award-winning operations team, to flexible pet friendly policies, excellent service and exclusive benefits. Everything has been thought about to make your life easier and enhance your everyday.
keyFeatures: Brand new 1 bed 1 bathroom luxury apartment
Live in the centre of the Northern Quarter
Amenity spaces that take life to the next level
7th floor roof terrace, residents lounge and co-working space
Urban garden with communal and private hire space
